mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for UNRATE threshold signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110) and rising manufacturing capacity utilization, supply chain constraints intensify, leading to higher inflation and reduced corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal in supply contraction regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.4 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL threshold signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a labor market mismatch where job creation outpaces labor force participation, increasing wage pressures and inflation, which triggers a Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), the Federal Reserve is in a tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
